best_idea: Commit attackers against the gap still uncovered, using a superlinear group rating, so a crowd reads as more threat than the sum of its members while a target out of sight decays slowly.
decision_why: Keep the superlinear group threat and commit-only-the-gap rule to decide how many of the three attacker slots a target needs, plus slow memory for a target out of view; reject the 4X supply, planet and tier system, which does not map onto a duel.
acceptance: A server test asserts that three attackers of equal rating r give group threat 9r (not 3r), a fourth attacker is queued rather than committed while three hold the target, and a target out of view keeps at least 0.98 of its last threat for the next turn (retuned per tick if adopted).
